svg.text: lochness bench layout (stage 1): parts on hand, one 830-point breadboard
Generated by build_wiring.py from wiring/bench.py. Same GPIO map as the dev kit, so the same firmware runs on both. Hole = row (1-63) + column (a-j) or rail.
Power: USB into the DevKit (its 3V3 and 5V feed the rails). 2x 18650 in series -> MP1584 (set to 6.0 V BEFORE connecting) -> TB6612 VM. All grounds common.
USB-C ports off the board's end
check the pin order on yours
J1 pins in column i, J3 pins in column b; pin 1 (3V3 / G) in row 17, pin 16 (NC) in row 2
Antenna towards row 20, USB-C ports hanging off the row-1 end
Control row (PWMA..GND) in column c, power row (VM..GND) in column h, rows 22-29
PWMA and VM in row 22; check your board's silkscreen order
Branded (flat) face towards the centre gap (column e), so VCC, GND, OUT run left to right as you face it
